framework.ep_group_created_when: config.model_config is None or config.model_config.is_moe, in distributed/parallel_state.py initialize_model_parallel; enable_expert_parallel is not part of the condition
framework.use_ep: dp_size_ * pcp_size_ * tp_size_ > 1 and vllm_parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel, in model_executor/layers/fused_moe/config.py FusedMoEParallelConfig.make
framework.ep_off_config: ep_size=1, ep_rank=0, use_ep=False, tp_size and tp_rank from flatten_tp_across_dp_and_pcp
framework.flatten_tp_rank: dp_rank * pcp_size * tp_size + pcp_rank * tp_size + tp_rank
framework.expert_tensor_shard: FusedMoEConfig.__post_init__ asserts intermediate_size % tp_size == 0 and sets intermediate_size_per_partition = intermediate_size // tp_size against the flattened tp_size
framework.ep_off_local_experts: determine_expert_map returns (global_num_experts, None, None) when ep_size == 1, in model_executor/layers/fused_moe/expert_map_manager.py

round_robin_fallback.resolver: model_executor/layers/fused_moe/expert_map_manager.py determine_expert_placement_strategy, called from ExpertMapManager.__init__ only when moe_parallel_config.use_ep
round_robin_fallback.supported: (num_expert_group is not None and num_expert_group > 1) and num_redundant_experts == 0 and not enable_eplb
round_robin_fallback.use_all2all_kernels: use_ep and (dp_size > 1 or pcp_size > 1 or is_sequence_parallel)
round_robin_fallback.needs_round_robin_routing_tables: use_deepep_ll_kernels or use_nixl_ep_kernels, i.e. all2all_backend in (deepep_low_latency, nixl_ep)
round_robin_fallback.second_resolver: ExpertMapManager._determine_placement_strategy returns linear when ep_size == 1 and again on the same backend condition

framework.eplb_divisibility_refusal: model_executor/layers/fused_moe/layer.py raises ValueError when use_ep and global_num_experts % ep_size != 0, inside the enable_eplb branch only; the else arm asserts num_redundant_experts == 0
framework.eplb_group: distributed/parallel_state.py creates the eplb group with the same rank lists as ep under if config.parallel_config.enable_eplb
framework.model_refusal: sixteen sparse-MoE blocks under model_executor/models raise ValueError('Tensor parallel size {tp_size} is greater than the number of experts {num_experts}.'), among them qwen3_moe.py, mimo_v2.py, laguna.py, cohere2_moe.py, minimax_m2.py; tp_size is get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
framework.model_uniform_blocks: deepseek_v2.py, mixtral.py, qwen3_moe.py and transformers/moe.py compute n_local_physical_experts = n_physical_experts // ep_size with physical_expert_start = ep_rank * n_local_physical_experts; gpt_oss.py uses experts_per_rank = num_experts // ep_size; none raises
